decisions.why: the division's own products are electrosurgical consumables — single use and reusable bipolar forceps, bipolar cables, blade / needle / tungsten microdissection electrodes, diathermy plates, suction coagulators, smoke evacuation pencils and footswitches — and it separately names Single Use Laparoscopic Electrodes, which are MIS consumables

the division holds single use forceps, scissors, needle holders, scalpel handles, sponge holders, speculums, probes / hooks / elevators / curettes, cannulas / suction / dilators and procedure packs — single-use surgical instruments only

orthopaedic burrs, surgical saw blades, twist drills and single use pulse lavage are orthopaedic equipment; the bone cement mixing bowl and bone cement syringe mixer are cement preparation; Kirschner wires, Steinman & Denham pins and guide wires are trauma fixation — the division's own list names all three

surgical drapes, medical covers, patient straps & belts and theatre accessories are general theatre consumables; the same division separately names surface and floor disinfectants, high level disinfectant, automatic washing and disinfector solutions and disinfectant sprays and wipes for medical devices, which are cleaning chemicals and consumables

face shields, protective goggles, face masks, isolation gowns, protective coveralls and aprons are general PPE. The glove line is named only as 'Examination Gloves' with no material stated, so no material-specific glove category is claimed
surgical gowns, surgical clothing, medical masks, medical caps and shoe covers are theatre-worn consumables
